q.en: A vendor has been contracted by a buyer to develop a new device . The buyer does not have clear requirements upfront and , therefore , requested that the vendor develop the device using agile. The vendor delibers as per the contract , but the buyer is not satisfied with the outcome. Which Agile manifesto's value was most likely not approptiately applied?

en: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools
Business people and developers must work together
Pair programming over continuous integration
Customer collaboration over contract negotiations.

x.en: In the scenario , however , the customer does not have detailed requirements upfront and requests that the vendor develops the device using agile methods . Collaboration over negotiations would be more beneficial for both parties.

q.en: You have been hired as an agile expert for an organization that is in the transition phase from predictive to the agile approach in project management. The organization has recently embarked upon the Agile journey . Which of the following is not a change - friendly characteristics for organizations beginning to use Agile approaches

en: Executive management's commitment
Focus on short -term budgeting and metrics versus long -term goals
Talent management maturity and capabilities
Existence of department silos

x.en: If the organization is decomposed into department silos , that prevents accelerated delivery and doesn't encourage forming across- functional teams . The rest of the choices are desirable attributes . [ Agile Practice Guide . 1st edition , pages 73,74]

q.en: One of your project team members doesn't finish his tasks on time . As a project manager, what should you do next ?

en: Release a team member
Conduct one-on-one meeting with the team member
Schedule training sessions for the team member to optimize his performance
Meeting with the project team members and evaluate the impact on the project

x.en: The first step is to Conduct one-on-one meeting with the team member to understand why he leaves the site early and why he does not finish his tasks on time

q.en: As a project manager , you are leading a software development project as a result of observation and conversation , you notice some of the team members need to improve their skills . What should you do first

en: update cost baseline
Review the resource management plan
acquire new members
update risk register

x.en:
The correct answer is Review the resource management plan .
Resource management plan include (Training strategies and Mehods for developing the project team. [PMBOK 6th edition , page 319]

q.en: Situational awareness is a key interpersonal skill for all effective project managers and means knowing what is going on around you and being able to quickly switch your focus. What another skill is often used in conjunction with situatioanl awareness where you the project manager , have to be persuasive in expressing your point and position in order for your project team and stakeholders to react quickly to changing project priorities?

en: influencing
negotiation
Leadership
conflict management

x.en: Influencing is an interpersonal skill that involves awareness of , and consideration for the various perspectives in any situation. It helps you gather relevant and critical information in order to address changing project priorities and resolve unexpected project challenges . It is often used in conjunction with the situational awareness interpersonal tool [PMBOK 6th edition, Page 350]

q.en: Your project is very complex and due to a scope change , you need a few additional experts , which you did not think of earlier . You request that your company provide you with some experts for consultancy work . Although your company has provided you with those experts , they are located in a different geographical location. In this situation , how will you get their input?

en: Ask management to bring them to you
Recruit new members with same skills
choose from current employees
Create a virtual team

x.en: If your experts are located in different geographical locations and you need their input , you will create a virtual team including all these experts [PMBOK 6th edition, Page 333]

q.en: Two team members on your project often disagree . You need a conflict resolution method that provides a long - term resolution. You decide to use which one of the following approaches

en: Compromise
Problem solving
Smoothing
Withdrawal

x.en: Problem solving / Collabotation is long -term resolution while incorporating multiple viewpoint and insights from differing perspectives. This strategy can result in a win -win situation

q.en: While you are in one of the first meetings for your new project that you have been assigned to early, two team memebrs were discussing new ideas that each one thinks is correct and their opinion is the best for the project . You didn't interact or cut the discussion , as you know this is a normal discussion in this phase , which is?

en: Norming
Adjourning
Storming
Performing

x.en: Storming Phase ----- Team members argue and are not openly collaborative while each one thinks is correct and their opinion is the best for the project.

q.en: A project manager wants to recruit another team member to replace an architect who resigned . What document should capture this change .

en: Responsibility assignment matrix ( RAM )
Project management plan
Organizational Process Assets
Ground rule

x.en: Responsibility assignment matrixs ( RAM ) are used to designare roles , responsibilities and levels of authority for specific activities.

q.en: Your project team members have just started to work together and are now adjusting their work habits and behaviors to support each other. Which stages of the Tuckman ladder has your team just enterned and once the current stage ends , what is the next stage?

en: The current stage is Forming and the next stage is Norming
The current stage is Forming and the next stage is Storming
The current stage is Performing and the next stage is Adjourning
The current stage is Norming and the next stage is Performing

x.en: The current stage is Norming and the next stage is Performing

q.en: During a project that affects the entire organization, some groups of stakeholders appear to have low product expectations. As a result, they are not performing as expected . This may put project objectives at risk . What should the project manager do?

en: Ask the project sponsor to intervene and motivate the under performing stakeholders.
Submit a change request
Follow the stakeholder engagement plan
اطلب من راعي المشروع التدخل وتحفيز أصحاب المصلحة ذوي الأداء الضعيف.

x.en: Keywords ( Stakeholders appear to have low product expectations) ------- The stakeholder engagement plan is a component of the project management plan that identifies the strategies and actions required to promote the productive involvement of stakeholders in decision making and execution. It can be formal or informal and highly detailed or broadly framed, based on the needs of the project and the expectations of stakeholders. The stakeholder engagement plan may include but is not limited to specific strategies or approaches for engaging with individuals or groups of stakeholders. PMBOK 6th page ,522

q.en:
A company has always utilized a predictive approach to project management, but now the project management office wants to incorporate some agile best practices to generate earlier revenue realization.
The project manager is about to begin planning for the new project and is concerned that the project team is not equipped to work in a hybrid environment. What is the project manager's best course of action?

en: Check the lessons learned repository for agile best practices
Request the training from the project management office (PMO)
Empower the team to self-organized and study agile best practices
Add the risk of the team's inadequate agile skills to the risk register

x.en: The PMO will typically provide project managers with resources to improve productivity. In this case , the PMO may or may not have internal resources with the necessary knowledge to provide agile training . However , the PMO should be able to provide guidance and external resources, if needed , to train the project team on agile best practices.

q.en:
A project manager is in charge of managing a large construction project of 4 billion USD. Various teams from different countries are involved in this project and the teams need to work cohesively and seamlessly for the success of the project . The task of one team member is highly dependent on that of other team members.
Which of the following is important for the overall success of project integration?

en: Detailed definition of the work packages
Change management
Communications management plan
Adherence of professional code of conduct

x.en: Communication management plan is vital for the success of project integration.

q.en:
You are the project manager of a project to solve customer service problems in your company's call center.
During the execution phase , several quality defects have been discovered , causing customer concern . You would like to create a chart showing the frequency of problems and the causes that have the largest number of defects . Which tool shows defects by volume from greatest to least?

en: Ishikawa Diagram
Flowchart
Pareto Chart
Matrix diagrams

x.en: Keyword ( greatest to least) A pareto chart is specific type of histogram that ranks causes or issues by their overall influence . A Pareto Chart assists in prioritizing corrective actions as the issues with the greatest impact are displayed in order.

q.en: The risk breakdown structure (RBS) helps the project team consider the full range of sources from which individual project risks that may arise. The second level of RBS include Regulatory and Legislation. In which category are these risk included?

en: External Risk
Technical Risk
Internal Risk
Management Risk

q.en: As a project manager , you know the importance of risk management. You always try to include risk management as an agenda item in your status meetings. Some of your project team members complain that discussing risk management issues in status meetings is a waste of time because none of the risks identified on the project so far have actually occurred. What should you do in this situation ?

en: Call a meeting with your project sponsor and project management team to discuss potential training requirements for your project team members .
Talk to your team members about the importance of risk management .
Agree with your team members and let them know no more time will be spent on discussing risks in the project status meetings unless required in the future.
Call a meeting with your project sponsor and project management team to discuss potential training requirements for your project team members .

x.en: Project risk management should be an agenda item at periodic status meetings. The amount of time required for that item will vary depending on the risks that have been identified, their priority, and difficulty of planning an appropriate response. But completely avoiding discussion on project risks is not adisable. Organizations should be committed to addressing risks proactively throughout the project life cycle.

q.en: You have just been assigned as the project manager for an ongoing project in your organization . You have discovered there is no project charter that describes the responsibilities and authorities of the project manager. When you talked to your project sonsor about this issue , he told you that your organization has executed many projects in the past without ever using a project charter. What will you do

en: Discuss the need to have a project charter with the sponsor
Conduct the project kick-off meeting and inform everyone that the project has started
Create the project charter and inform project team members to ensure common understanding of the key deliverables and their roles and responsibilities
Create a draft project charter and submit to your supervisor

x.en: The project charter establishes a partnership between the performing and requesting organizations. Projects are initiated by an entity external to the project such as a sponsor , program , or project management office , or portfolio governing body chairperson or authorized representative. The project initiator or sponsor is responsible for approval ans issue the charter and can take the help of the prospect project manager to develop it [PMBOK 6th edition , Page 77]

q.en: You are a project manager in an IT project . You and key stakeholders start conducting a project benefit analysis . Because of the solutions that have not been identified, an engineer from another department has informed you that there are affected systems. As a project manager , what should you do ?

en: Review the project benefit analysis to consider the additional impact
Document the issue in the issue log
Identify all stakeholders
Update the risk register

x.en: Issue log is a project document used to identify and monitor issues that occur in the project. The issue log can be updated with any new issues found during the project and described in the scenario because of the solutions that have not been identified causing the system are affected

q.en: The marketing team is transferring to using hybrid approaches for their projects . The marketing director is not knowledgeable about hybrid methodologies. And the project manageer needs the director's support as the marketing director is a key stakeholder. What should the project manager do to obtain the support?

en: Mentor the marketing director on hybrid approaches
Ask the marketing team members to coach the director
Train the marketing team and keep the director informed
Ask the marketing director to participate in daily meetings

x.en: Marketing director is a key stakeholder who has high power , high interest the project manager should follow strategy manage closely with him and project manager should mentor the marketing director on hybrid approaches.

q.en: An agile project is running activities to define the minimum viable product . During the session , the project manager identifies some mandatory regulations , but there is no consensus to include these regulations in the minimum viable product because if may extend the duration of the project. What should the project manager do ?

en: Ask the project sponsor to add more time to the project
Share with the participants the need to focus only on product functionality
Train the team on the new regulations are requested by management
Get commitment from the team to include all of the required regulations

x.en: In order to determine a usable product for the customer in each increment , the core value must be understood . Based on the essential value sought by the project , the bare minimum of how the value can be realized is established . As there are mandatory regualtions that must be included ,the project manager should Get commitment from the team to include all of the required regulations

q.en: In a hybrid project, the customer has issued a contract that specifies the deliverables for each quarter. The customer wants to show their stakeholders a tangible outcome in the first quarter and wants to move the second milestone to the first quarter. The project manager explains to the customer that it is not feasible unless the requirements for the second milestone are changed. Which two actions should the project manger take? Chosse two

en: Tell the customer that moving the milestone has a very high impact on the cost of the project.
Convince the customer to leave the second milestone in place and not change it
Escalate the issue to upper management to resolve the problem and suggest a plan
Ask the customer for their priorities regarding the requirements for the second milestone

x.en:
Keyword (The project manager explains to the customer that it is not feasible unless the requirements for the second milestone are changed). so the two actions should the project manger take 

 Ask the customer for their priorities regarding the requirements for the second milestone
 
 Convince the customer to leave the second milestone in place and not change it

q.en: The project team suggests to the project manager that there is no reason to perform quality control since the project tasks are very simple, The project manager understands that removing the quality management plan from the project will also help to save money, which is important to the customer. What should the project manager do ?

en: Ask the customer to order an external quality audit after accepting the project deliverable , and decrease the budget of the project
Develop the quality management plan , as quality is as equally importance as cost and schedule management
Get confirmation from management that the team member has enough experience to build software without quality control
Register starting the project without a quality management plan as a risk , and allocate the budget savings to the management reserve

x.en: The quality management plan cannot be ignored, as it is considered as important as any other plan in the project, where the success of the project depends on the integration of plans and the inclusion of all necessary plans such as the quality management plan, cost, scope, resources, risks, procurement, stakeholders, communications and schedule, and including them in a project management plan

q.en:
You are a project manager managing a complex project with a high level of uncertainty . A request is made to implemet a method to measure the quality of the deliverables.
Using a hybrid approach , what techniques can be used to achieve this goals ?

en: Paired work and the customer role method
Scrum master reviews and the quality Kanban method
Daily scrum and product owner quality assessments
Time-boxing iterations and review meetings

x.en:
The Best Option (Time-boxing iterations and review meetings) since the project manager use a hybrid approach and the project is complex.
Time-boxing to address with a high level of uncertainty
Review meeting to measure the quality of the deliverables

q.en: A key stakeholders wants to understand when the risk may potentially become an issue. What artifact should the project manager share with the stakeholders

en: Issue log
Project management plan
Risk management plan
Risk register

x.en:
A Risk Register is a document you use to record:

 
 All of your organisation’s identified risks
 
 
 The likelihood and consequences of a risk occurring,
 
 
 The actions you are undertaking to reduce those risks 
 
 
 Who is responsible for managing them.

q.en: You are a project manager of a company. The sponsor is supportive in leveraging agile approaches. The project manager s contemplating how to roll out the agile approach and gam buy-in from both project team members and stakeholders.What should the project manager do first?

en: Determine which agile software tools will be required to support agile delivery within the organization
Determine how to transform the organization using agile techniques , including organizational training and communications
Start with a pilot project of appropriate complexity and provide agile training to those who are impacted
Select a current predictive project, define the approach , and provide agile training to execute the remainder of the project

x.en: If project manager want to transform the organization to use an agile approach he should first Start with a pilot project of appropriate complexity and provide agile training to those who are impacted

q.en: During the implementation phase of a construction project, a key supplier went bankrupt and cannot supply the contracted material. This issue could affect the project schedule. What should the project manager do first?

en: Update the schedule to include the delay
Update the issue log and act to minimize the impact
Escalate to the management team for delay approval
Add the risk and the delay to the risk register

x.en:
Keyword ( supplier went bankrupt and cannot supply the contracted material -The issue ) so there is issue no risk
The issue is certain event or condition has negative impact (is in the past) . the project manager add and update the issue in issue log .
But the risk is uncertain event or condition has positive or negative impact.

The project manager should add and update the risk in risk register.
so in real exam should read the question and identify this is risk or issue in this scenario this is issue so the project manager should update issue log.

q.en:
A new project manager has been assigned to a project that is in danger of failling the stakeholders do not know the project status nor do they know what benefits will be delivered by the project.

How can the project manager convey these benefits to the stakeholders?

en: Re-baseline the project schedule to show the current status of the project
Update the deliverables map against the agreed-upon project requirements
Perform a project cost -benefit analysis for the stakeholders
Create a benefits management plan mapped to the organization's strategic objectives

x.en: Cost-Benefit Analysis help to make the right decisions and to ensure that the benefits will be delivered according to the benefits management plan.

q.en: An agile team is brainstorming and prioritizing all of the risks according to severity. What should the team do about the identified risks?

en: Agree that any issue can be handled when it becomes a problem
Acknowledge that the risks will be handled in the corresponding iterations
Focus on the project deliverables rather than the documented risks
Mitigate the risks that are applicable to the current and following iterations

x.en: To prioritize all of the risks according to severity the project manager should Mitigate the risks that are applicable to the current and following iterations .

q.en: In the middle of an iteration , an agile team working on the development of a new product was notified that an important team member will leave the project for a few weeks due to some urgent personal issues. What should the project manager do regarding the activities that were the responsibility of this team member?

en: Reach an agreement with the team on how to handle the situation
Allow senior management to decide how to proceed with the project
Reach out to the procurement team to hire a substitute for the team member
Convince the team member not to leave until the project is completed

x.en: Since it's an agile project and we are in the middle of an iteration, the project manager sould Reach an agreement with the team on how to handle the situation .

q.en: A new project manager was assigned to a project during implementation. The project manager realized that new tax policies are creating a risk for a cost overrun by 25% . The project manager updated the risk register and kept the project running as normal. The CEO has announced that the project could be canceled since the acceptable cost overrun is only 20%. The project manager was quite surprised as this was new information. What should the project manager have done to avoid this?

en: Provided a proper risk response
Implemented the communications management plan properly
Ensured the risk tolerance of the company was properly updated
Implemented the stakeholder engagement plan correctly

x.en:
Keyword ( new information) .
communication management plan include information

q.en: A project manager is leading a technically complex project. The project is part of a strategic program of work and the first to use an agile approach. One of the board members is interested in attending a meeting to see how the delivery of the project scope is progressing. What should the project lead do ?

en: Invite the board member to the next daily standup
Invite the board member to the next sprint planning
Invite the board member to the next sprint review
Invite the board member to the next sprint retrospective

x.en: Keyword (how the delivery of the project scope is progressing) so the best option sprint review . Sprint review : is held at the end of a sprint , during which the team demonstrate what was accomplished and give feedback .

q.en: A customer reviewed the plan for a project with high uncertainty. The customer expressed concerned about the work requiring so many iterations with a risk of not reaching the mandatory delivery date. Which approach should the project manager use in this situation?

en: Agile approach
Hybrid approach
Waterfall approach
Predictive approach

x.en:
Uncertainty means either Iterative or Incremental (Adaptive). Hybrid cannot be it here since there is no chance of being Predictive for any of the part of the project. This Cannot be Kanban since there is a deadline. Hence the option is only left as Agile.
When things are not clear go with agile. Even in your answers try following agile, it works.
Agile project management begins with the premise that software projects are not predictable. Market uncertainty is going to drive change. The more uncertain we are about our projects, the more the organization must plan to adapt. The implication of market uncertainty is that requirements will need to be changed over the life of the project.

q.en: A project manager has just taken over a project to develop a product using a hybrid life cycle. With this project, the hardware has fixed requirements while the software requirements are still evolving. How should the project manager apply the hybrid life cycle for this project?

en: Both the hardware and software should have their scope defined iteratively
Both the hardware and software should have their scope defined during initial project planning
Develop the software with a predictive life cycle and use an adaptive life cycle the hardware
Develop the hardware with a predictive life cycle and use an adaptive life cycle for the software

x.en:
In this scenario , the hardware has fixed requirements so the project manager should develop the hardware with a predicitive life cycle since the project scope,time , and cost are determined in the early phases of the life cycle.
while the software requirements are still evolving so the project managershould develop software with an adaptive life cycle .
A hybrid development life cycle is a combination of predicitive an adaptive life cycles.

q.en: You have recommended developing a business case for each of the organizational projects followed by the development of a project benefits management plan. Who would you recommend to be the owner of the business case ?

en: Project manager
Change Control Board
Project team
Project sponsor

x.en: The project sponsor is generally accountable for the development and maintenance of the project business case document. The project manager is responsible for providing recommendations and oversight to keep the project business case, project management plan , project charter , and project benebfits management plan success measures in alignment with one another and with the goals and objectives of the organization. [ PMBOK Guide , 6th edition, Page 29 ]

q.en: An Agile team is currently developing an inventory control system. Two programmers on the team are arguing and recommending different development approaches . One is of the view that the system should be built from scratch, while the other believes that the existing system should be enhanced and patched. How should you resolve this conflict?

en: Develop the product from scratch as that wi11 bring the system closer to requirements
Ask the product owner to choose the right approach.
Ask the entire team to analyze both approaches and select the one that will deliver higher business value.
Select the patch work approach as that will save time for the organization

x.en: This has to be a team decision so Ask the entire team to analyze both approaches and select the one that will deliver higher business value. [ Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition, Page 4 ]

q.en: Which feature should the team prioritize first?

en: C
D
B
A

To prioritize features
Feature Name = Business Value / Development effort
A= 6/2 = 3
B=10/4= 2.5

The initiatives that the deliver the highest value and require the least effort will represent the top-priority item to add to your product backlog.

q.en: Using the following values , calculate the management reserve : Project Budget = 100,000 - EAC = 120,000 - AC = 5,500 - BAC = 70,000

x.en: The Management Reserve = Project Budget - BAC = 100,000-70,000 = 30,000

q.en: You are project manager for an infrastructure project. Your project team members report monthly on their assigned activities . What should you di to maintain a healthy cash flow?

en: Perform a qualitative
Provide project reports
Team building activities
Apply earned value (EV) principles

x.en: Earned Value Management helps project managers to measure project performance .It is a systematic project management process used final variances in projects based on comparison of work performed and work planned. Earned Value Management is used on the cost and schedule control and can be very useful in project forecasting. Earned Value Manageemnt (EVM) provides quantitative data for project decision making.

q.en: Which of the following is an example of an external failure cost

en: Warranty cost
Cost of documentation
Cost of testing
Cost of training

x.en: Warranty cost is the cost that belongs to the category of external failure cost.

q.en: Ibrahim has been running a project . While performing a quality audit he found that the team memebers have committed a number of minor mistakes while producing the product of the project. He is concerned about whether or not the project processes are under control. Which of the following tools should he use to clear his doubts?

en: Bar Chart
Ishikawa Diagram
Control Chart
Histogram

x.en: Control charts illustrate how a process behaves over time and when a process is subject to special cause variation, resulting in an out of control condition. The appropriate data is collected and analyzed to indicate the quality status of project processes and products.

q.en: A quality assurance subject matter expert SME discovered that the formulation team didn't follow complaiance procedures while manufacturing a drug. What shpuld the project manager have done to prevent this issue?

en: Reviewed the quality baseline document
Reviewed the quality management plan
Reviewed the quality metrics document
Reviewed the quality improvement document

x.en:
Keyword (team didn't follow complaiance procedures while manufacturing a drug) .

Quality Management Plan includes the major procedures relevant for the project, such as dealing with nonconformance, corrective actions procedures, and continous improvement procedures.

q.en: A project team is analyzing a major , critical defect to determine the root cause. In order to do this , the team considered various factors linked to the defects and grouped them into categorizes such as Machine , Method , Material , and Manpower. Which of the following tools of quality is the team using?

en: Histogram
Control chart
Cause - and -effect diagram
Flowchart

x.en: Cause - and - effect diagrams are also known as fishbone diagrams, why-why diagrams, or Ishikawa diagrams. This type of diagram breaks down the causes of the problem statement identified into discrete branches, helping to determine the main or root cause of the problem. [PMBOK 6th edition ,Page 293]

q.en: You are monitoring the status of a project to update the project progress and manage changes to the schedule baseline. You have some resources assigned to more than one activity simultaneously , making them overallocated during those days. You want to reduce this overallocation and keep resource usage at a constant level. What technique should you use to achieve this goal ?

en: Resource Allocation
Resource Compression
Schedule Compression
Resource leveling

x.en:
Resource leveling is used to reduce overallocation and to keep resource usage at a constant level.

This technique can be used in both the develop schedule process and the control schedule process.

q.en: A client approaches a design team member requesting that a current task be stopped and a new concept the developed. This will significantly change the design, and impact the project budget and schedule. The team member asks the project manager for the next course of action. What should the project manager do ?

en: Hold a team meeting to discuss the request
Accept the request and make the changes
Ask the client to refrain from directly contracting team members.
Refer to the perform integrated change control process

x.en: Since the new concept be developed will significantly change the design, and impact the project budget and schedule , the project manager should refer to the perform integrated change control process to manage this change.

q.en: You are a project manager of a company , and your project is currently in the execution phase. One of your project teams leave the site early at 3:00 pm friday and mistreats his colleagues. You would like to establish clear expectations regarding the acceptable behavior of the team member. To avoid such situations , you should create:

en: Interpersonal skills
Management skills
Team-building activities
The team charter

x.en: The team charter establishes clear rxpectations regarding acceptable behavior by project team members [PMBOK 6th edition, Page 320]

q.en: A lead business analyst on a large project has consistently been working late to finalize requirements for the next sprint. The weekly team lead meeting. The project manager learns there are several business analysts on the team who have free cycles. What should the project manager do to ensure an even workload?

en: Delay the start date of the next sprint to allow more time for gathering requirements
Direct the business analysts with free cycles to take more ownership of the project
Review the list of open requirements and reassign them to team members with free cycles
Facilitate a discussion within the team to redistribute the work within the project team

x.en: The best option when there is open discussion with team. in the scanario the project manager learns there are several business analysts who have free cycle so the project manager should facilitate a discussion within the team to redistribute the work within the project team

q.en: A project is six months into its nine - month projected duration , and the project manager is reporting that the project is at least three months behind schedule because certain key stakeholders were resistant to any changes that might occur as outcomes of the project. What might have been done differently during project planning to have avoided this situation

en: Establishment of more robust communications management plan
Development of a stakeholder engagement assessment matrix
Better execution of the manage stakeholder engagement processes
Creation of a comprehensive stakeholder register

x.en: The scenario describe a situation where the resistance of certain key stakeholders has caused the project to run behind schedule and is asking what might have been done differently during the project planning. q.en: The government sponsors a project to construct a new highway. The assigned project manager communicates to stakeholders that the project charter was approved. The project manager is working on the project management plan and receives an email from an environmental organization asking for the objectives and start date of the project. What should the project manager do to address the situation?

en: Update the communication management plan accordingly
Conduct a brainstorming session with the stakeholders and the team
Conduct a stakeholder analysis and communicate to stakeholders accordingly
Respond to the email with the requested information

x.en: Since the project in the planning phase and the environmental organization did not identified before , the project manager should first Conduct a stakeholder analysis to learn about their major requirements ,expectations , the potential for influencing project outcomes and communicate to stakeholders accordingly

q.en: A project manager focuses on systems and structure to accomplish project goals. As a result , the project manager has a strained relationship with the project team. Although the current project is trending to meet project objectives, excessive turnover of the project team threatens the project. For self improvement , what type of skills should the project manager spend time developing?

en: Communication skills
Leadership skills
Management Skills
Operational and problem solving skills

x.en: The strained relationship with the project team suggests that the project manager lacks in leadership skills to foster better relationships

q.en: You are leading a software development project, which requires knowledge of several programming languages . During project execution , one of the developers has been pulled out of the project by her functional manager. The manager provided you with another developer instead. What should you do first?

en: Schedule training for the new developer
Provide the new developer with an ability test
Introduce the new developer to the project sponsor
Assign the developer the next user story in the backlog

x.en: An ability test would provide an assessment of the new developer's existing competencies in order to determine what, if any,gaps in skill set exist and how they might be addressed.

q.en: You have been assigned to lead an agile project. You want to ensure that project information is shared within and across the organzation, so that any misalignments , dependencies , or other issues related to the frequently changing requirements are surfaced as quickly as possible. How could this goal be best achieved?

en: By promoting aggressive transparency
By sharing comprehensive documentation
By distribution the project report weekly
By inviting stakeholders to daily stand-ups

x.en: In order to accelerate the sharing of information within and across the organization , agile methods promote aggressive transparency. Inviting stakeholders to project meetings and reviews or posting project artifacts in public spaces would help surface any misalignments , dependencies , or other issues related to the frequently changing project.

q.en: Your organization's PMO is periodically asking for project artifacts from all projects and checking whether corporate standards of project management are being adhered to or not. They are also supportive in providing templates and guidelines related to project management when asked. Which type of PMO are we referring

en: Governing PMO
Directing PMO
Controlling PMO
Supporting PMO

x.en: In this scenario The PMO is assisting with templates and guidelines like a suportive PMO + checking whether corporate standards ,so they are playing the bigger role of a controlling PMO here .

q.en: The project manager to build a concrete waterfall at a theme park likes to plan everything upfront and follow the waterfall method. However, the customer doesn't want everything fixed from the beginning , as she may change her mind in a number of areas once the project is underway, and needs to be sure that the project management can allow for flow on effects. What sort of ptoject life cycle should the project manager use

en: Tacit
Adaptive
Explicit
Predictive

x.en: Keyword ( she may change her mind in a number of areas once the project is underway) . The customer ask about Adaptive life cycle = Agile / Change driven , the deliverables are developed over multiple iterations where a detailed scope is defined asd approved for each iteration when it begins.

q.en: You are managing a construction project. After identifying risks , you start the qualitative risk analysis process and now you are going to prioritize them. Which of the following techniques are you going to use ?

en: Sensitive analysis
Scatter diagram
Probability and impact matrix
Tornado diagram

x.en: Perform qualitative risk analysis process aims to priortize risks and focus on high risk so there are a lot of tools and techniques which used to priortize risks as Probability and Impact Matrix .

q.en: Two team members have been arguing with each other openly at meetings. Each team member individually spoke with the sponsor directly and made decisions without informed the project manager. What two actions should the project manager take? Choose two.

en: Ask the team members to work it out themselves
Discuss this situation with other project managers and ask for advice
Address the behavioral issues with each team member
Discuss the behavior directly with their managers and request them to correct the behavior
Reiterating ground rules at the next meeting and ensure that all team members are clear about these rules.

x.en:
Two actions should the project manager take

 Address the behavioral issues with each team member 
 
 Reiterating ground rules at the next meeting and ensure that all team members are clear about these rules.

q.en: You have just replaced a project manager who was managing a city street light installation project. The project is in its execution phase. The new project manager has issues with some undiscovered risks on previous projects. What document should the new project manager reference to ensure that all possible risks are involved in risk identification?

en: Probability and Impact Matrix
Stakeholder register
Risk register
Project charter

x.en:
Keyword (Involved in risk identification) because the output of risk identifications is Risk Register
Risk Register provides the details of all identified risks and their characteristics , that affect the project.

q.en: You know that the success of your project will be determined by how well you manage risks. You know that identifying risks upfront can help you be better prepared with risk response strategies. You discuss and consult with other project managers in the company. One manager suggests the usage of SWOT to identify risks. What would you do next as a part of this technique?

en: Gather anonymous responses from experts and identify risks
Gather team members and experts together and discuss to identify risks
Perform root cause analysis to identify problems , their cause , and potential response
Identify the organization's strengths and weaknesses

x.en:
SWOT technique refers to
S= Strengths
W= Weaknesses
O=Opportunities
T= Threats
So SWOT technique to identify Strengths and Weaknesses of the organization.

q.en: Your program manager has advised that you need to protect the organization from financial risk. In planning a new project , you realize there is a limited scope definition related to the work required to fulfill the contract. What is the best type of contract to choose?

en: Cost Plus Incentive Fee (CPIF)
Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF)
Fixed Price Incentive Fee (FPIF)
Time and Material (T&M)

x.en: Keyword ( a limited scope) . When you habe a project with limited scope, the most suitable type of contract is Cost-reimbursable contracts. This type should be used if the scope of work is expected to change significantly during the execution of the contract. We have two types of cost reimbursable contracts in the options given ( Cost plus incentive fee and cost plus a fixed fee). Both the risk lies on the buyer but cost plus incentive fee the risk is lower than the cost plus fixed fee where the buyer has to pay a fixed fee along with the cost incurred , but the cost plus incentive fee the buyer pays the fee based on achieving certain performance objectives mentioned in the contract.

q.en: A project manager feels the need of updating one of the project supplier contracts to meet the current needs of the project. However , before any change can be requested , the project manager must know the right process to incorporate a change to this specific contract. What should he do first?

en: Update the project procurement management plan
Review alternative dispute resolution (ADR) procedures in the contract
Review the change control procedure as documented in the contract
Issue the change request and get it approved through integrated change control process

x.en: The first step should be to gather enough information so that the right decision and course of action can be determined. The second step should be to issue a change request and follow its approval. The project manager must first review the change control procedure specific to the contract and that can be found in the procurement contract itself. [ PMBOK 6th edition, Page 489]

q.en: One of the sellers has completed their work as specified in the contract and you are proceeding to close out the purchase. Your quality team is not satisfied with the work as the machining tolerances are not as close as they had hoped for you need to do which of the following with the seller ?

en: Request that they rework the parts to the specified tolerances
Close out the procurement and start a new contract for any rework
Request from seller to issue a change request
Terminate the contract

x.en: The question states that the work is done to specifications. If you need to have some parts reworked a new contract needs to be written up. [PMBOK 6th edition, Page 499 ]

q.en: When do bidder conferences normally take place?

en: After submission of bid or proposal, but before contract award
Prior to the submission of a bid or proposal by the bidder
After technical meetings with bidders to discuss contract
After the contract has been awarded to keep alternative open

x.en: Bidder conferences is techniques used in the process " Conduct Procurement" , and the output of this is " Selected sellers" so it has to be before awarding the contract. But it takes place "prior to the submission" and not after "submission of bid" so that vendors can take inputs from these meetings before final submission. [PMBOK 6th edition, Page 487]

q.en: During project closure and transferring of the completed project deliverables to the operations group, the project manager discovers that an audit report from an early project phase is missing. What should the project manager do ?

en: Complete project closure and update the Organizational Process Assets (OPA)
Remove the audit report from the required project documents and update the project management plan
Ask the operations group to accept the project without the audit report.
Inform the operation group about the missing audit report

x.en: Ethically, the project manager must inform the operation group about the missing audit report.

q.en: You are a project manager in a software project. A development team completed the project and plans to initiate the closure phase. However , one key stakeholder refuses to sign-off due to non-compliance with the agreed-upon deliverables . What should the project manager do to facilitate acceptance?

en: Provide a new statement of work (SOW) for the variation in the deliverables
Document the noncompliance and start the change management process
Conduct a variance analysis to identify any deviation in the deliverables
Record the noncompliance and initiate project closure

x.en: First , the project manager should conduct a variance analysis to identify any deviation in the deliverables by comparing what was initially planned and the end result. [PMBOK 6th edition Page, 126 ]

q.en: What are the goals of contract closeout? (Choose three)

en: To provide a performance evaluation of seller staff
To update contract records and documents
To verify work was done and delivered to specification
To close the project
To arrange for final settlement of seller payments and claims

x.en:
The goals of contract closeout

 
 To arrange for final settlement of seller payments and claims
 
 
 To verify work was done and delivered to specification
 
 
 To update contract records and documents

q.en: As the project team gains better understanding of the value their product might deliver , they are excited to make the product a reality. Due to the volume of features and the work required, the project team decides to delivery incrementally . What are some benefits to this strategy? (Choose three)

en: Allows the team to discard or ignore the challenging
Enables the end users to provide feedback
Make senior leadership promote their work
Creates a sense of urgency to deliver part of a solution
Allows progress to be realized

x.en: Some benefits of using the incremental approach are enables the end -users to provide feedback and allow progress to be realized and creates a sense of urgency to deliver part of solution. An approach that provides finished deliverables that the customer may be able to use immediately. Some projects optimize for speed of delivery. Many businesses and initiatives cannot afford to wait for everything to be completed ; in these cases, customers are willing to receive a subset of the overall solution. This frequent delivery of smaller deliverables is called an incremantal life cycle.

q.en: A scrum team is midway into a sprint when the project sponsor approaches the scrum master and requests that a new , urgent , and potentially complex mandatory compliance -related requirement should be developed immediately in the current sprint . The sponsor stresses that if the requirement is not implemented , the entire project may be canceled . What is the scrum master's best response?

en: Submit a change request to update the scope baseline and add the requirement to the requirement traceability matrix.
Add the requirement to the current sprint backlog and direct the team to start working on it immediately.
Add the requirement to the product backlog and request the product owner to review the requirement after the sprint is over.
Discuss the requirements with the product owner , and let them make a decision , including sprint cancellation

x.en: The product owner is the appropriate authority to review new requirements and decide, together with the team, whether the requirements should be included in the prodcut backlog and in what sprint. The product owner may decide to cnacel the current sprint and start a new sprint that includes this new high priority requirement. In this case the teaة likely needs time to asses the impact of the new mandatory compliance- related requirement. The scrum master should discuss the new requirement with the product owner who , together with the team , may decide to cancel the sprint.

q.en: An issue that had not been registered as a risk a ppeared . This issue may have a big impact on the project. What should the project manager do ?

en: Avoid managing the issue as it was not registered as a risk for the project
Delay the project until the issue is addressed
Hold a meeting with the project team and relevant stakeholders to agree on the best way to manage the issues.
Inform the sponsor that the issue is addressed

x.en:
Very Important Question in Real Exam 
Issues are updated in the issue log, but we notice that this option is not among the available options, so we are thinking now why do we update issue in the issue log, as we will find out the causes of this issue , then put several solutions and choose the best solution, then implement the solution, then make sure that the solution contributed to solving the problem, then close the issue , and issue log is considered one of documents that can be viewed in the future. Always remember that there is a difference between a issue and a risk, as issue is an event or condition that has already occurred and has a negative impact, while risk is an event or condition that has not occurred yet, it is expected to occur and has a positive or negative impact. So in this scenario, it talks about issue and the best answer is that I assume that you have updated issue in issue log and you are expected to meet with the stakeholders and the team to find a solution, so this is the appropriate answer.
The international exam is not without questions related to problems and risks

The best option " Hold a meeting with the project team and relevant stakeholders to agree on the best way to manage the issues" .

q.en: A company is initiating a project to enhance one of its existing products. All of its products are developed internally. What should the project manager do ?

en: Create a lessons learned document for the initiation phase
Ensure the stakeholder engagement plan is accurate and properly documented.
Identify the risk of implementing the new solution and evaluate the impact on the project.
Review the lessons learned from the previous project.

x.en:
Very Important question In Real Exam 

Keyword (Initiating - Enhance one of its existing products) so the project manager should review the lessons learned from the previous project.

q.en: A project team is currently building a warehouse management system . Due to the complexity of the project and ambiguous requirements, the team decided to adopt an Agile management approach. If a higher rate of management process improvement is required by the project team, which of the following can help achieve this objective?

en: Frequent retrospectives and selecting improvements
Adopting XP for the development phase
Deferring the development until all requirements have been collected
Using a Kanban board to enable visual management

x.en: Keyword (Agile - Improve ) . Retrospectives can really facilitate process improvement by allowing the team to brainstorm on what went well and what went wrong [Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition , Page 32].

q.en: You and your team are executing the first Agile project in the organization. This is a special project for the organization as Agile is being piloted for the first time . You are nearing the end of the first iteration on the project and not all of the assigned user stories are complete. Can the team extend the iteration duration by a couple of days in order to complete all assigned stories in the iteration plan?

en: Yes, but requires the approval of the scrum master
Yes, but requires the approval of the product owner.
No, the iterations are time-boxed
Yes, but the extension cannot be more than 2 days

x.en: Agile is time boxed so the iteration durations cannot be extended. All incomplete stories need to be returned to the product backlog where they will get re-prioritized along with the other stories in the backlog. [Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition, Page 25]

q.en: The product owner has requested some major changes that will have a significant impact on the project and require reprioritizing the remaining backlog items. What should you do?

en: Complete the started stories but do not bring any more "Ready" stories into "WIP"
Terminate the current sprint and re-prioritize the entire project.
Complete the current iteration, re-prioritize the backlog and adapt the new plan for the next iteration.
Cancel the current sprint and immediately call a retrospective

x.en: Agile teams typically don't adjust their long term plan during a sprint unless all of the items being. Developed are dropped from the backlog. It is recommended to complete the current sprint and then re-plan and adjust accordingly. [Agile Practice Guide , 1st edition, Page 25]

q.en: Project life cycles can be shown on a continuum ranging from predictive cycles on one end, to Agile cycles on the other end , with more iterative or incremental cycles in the middle. Another approach is to visualize the continuum with a two-dimensional chart with the frequency of delivery on the Y-axis and the degree of change on the X-axis . What project life cycle should be proposed for the quadrant with a high degree of change and high frequency of delivery

en: Predictive
Iterative
Agile
Incremental

x.en: The Agile approach is recommended for projects that require a high degree of change and high frequency of project deliveries [Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition, Page 19]

q.en: You are managing the design and development of HR system . Your project calls for communication in the form of announcements and messages with an extremely large audience. What communication method would be appropriate under such circumstances

en: Pull Communication
Interaction Communication
Push Communication
Verbal Communication

x.en: Keyword (Large audiance) . Pull Communication is the best option for large audiances which it allows them to access information at their own discretion.

q.en: Agile teams use which of the following to collaboratively prioritize user stories based on their respective value to the project's customer

en: Backlog refinement
Kanban Board
Rolling wave planning
Retrospective

x.en: Refinement Backlog / Backlog grooming involves adding, removing and prioritizing stories in the product backlog. The purpose of refinement is to help the team understand whay the stories are and how large the stories are in relation to each other. [Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition , Page 52]

q.en:
A project manager receives a request for a proposal (RFP) from a client. The client is very clear about the requirements. A requirements analysis must be done in the first month of the project, and the client wants to see a demo of the work completed every two weeks.
What project approach should the project manager use ?

en: Predictive for the requirements analysis and agile for delivery for the project.
Predictive for the requirements analysis and delivery phases of the project
Iterative for the requirements analysis and delivery phases of the project.
Agile for all of the phases of the project , including the requirements analysis and delivery

x.en:
The client is very clear about the requirements so Predicitive is suitable for requirements.
but in this scenario client wants to see a demo of the work completed every two weeks so Agile is suitable for delivery.

q.en: A project team is currently analyzing its current iteration progress and reviewing the following chart. What is this chart called?

en: Histogram
Burnup Chart
Control Chart
Burndown Chart

x.en:
A burndown chart is a graphical representation of work left to do versus time. The outstanding work is shown on the vertical axis and time along the horizontal. It is useful for predicting when all of the work will be completed.

[PMBOK Guide ,6th edition, Page 226 ]

q.en: System requirements have been collected and the project scope has been defined. If one of the major project's success factors is delivering within the budget, which of the following approaches would you recommend to be used on this project?

en: Iterative
Incremental
Agile
Predictive

x.en: Predictive approach : Project requirements are fixed and the goal is to manage cost

q.en: You have been asked to develop a new website for one of your clients. The website is required to be browser independent and delivered within a month. Although the website has a simple design, the requirement of browser independence has added some complexity to the project. Which of the following approaches would you recommend for this project?

en: Predictive
Agile
Iterative
Incremental

x.en: Iterative life cycle : project requires a single final delivery. However, project work might require repetitions until all browsers are supported . An iterative approach is ideal in this situation .

q.en: You are working an a large project that is divided into the following phases: feasibility, conceptual, design,prototype,and build. You want to use the process groups with these different phases. What is recommended approach?

en: Assign one process group to each phase
Repeat all the five process groups for each phase
Eliminate your phase structure and rename each phase with one of the process group names
Skip a couple of the process groups since they don't apply to a large project.

x.en:
Process groups shouldnot be confused with project phases. Each phase should contain all of the process groups.

[PMBOK Guide 6th edition, page 19]

q.en: An agile team is struggling with coordinating work in progress. This is causing unnecessary conflicts and delays on the project. Which of the following two techniques can help this Situation?

en: Prototyping and backlog grooming
Story boards and retrospectives
Kanban boards and daily stand-ups
Gantt chart and backlog grooming

x.en: Help the team learn that they self-manage their work. Consider kanban boards to see the flow of work. Consider adaily stand-up to walk the board and see what work is where. [Agile Practice Guide , 1st edition, Page 58]

q.en: The project execution, the client provided updated requirements , which apparently will only require a minor adjustment to the work breakdown structure (WBS) . What should you do first?

en: Adjust the WBS as necessary as the change is minor
Submit a change request to update the scope baseline
Submit a change request to update the schedule baseline
Deny the request as it represents scope creep

x.en:
Very Important question in Real Exam 
The WBS is a component of the scope baseline.
An approved change request is required to update any of the project baselines including their components

q.en: If the deliverables will be produced using an agile framework . What strategies might be appropriate to gain formal acceptance of the product scope? (Choose two)

en: Ensure that the product scope is fully decomposed down to the work package level during initial project planning
Conduct a demonstration whenever enough features have been developed to from a coherent set
Have the team demonstrate the completed user stories to the product owner at the end of each iteration
Ask the product owner to attend each sprint retrospective to review and approve the completed product increment
Perform the validate scope process once the entire project scope is complete in accordance with the scope management plan

x.en: In flow-based agile , the development team will demonstrate the completed work once enough features have been developed to from a coherent set. Teams that use flow-based agile typically employ a kanban board to manage their workflow. In iteration -based agile , the project team should conduct an iteration review . During the iteration review , the project team demonstrates the completed work, and the product owner then accepts or declines the user stories.

q.en: A large project is affecting the neighborhood in which it is located. The neighbors are not satisfied with the project and their resistance to the project may affect the project deadline. What two actions should the project manager take ?(Choose two)

en: Send letters to the neighbors and ask them kindly not to disturb the project
Analyze the situation and find out what is causing the neighborhood's negative attitude
Set up a meeting with neighborhood representatives to win cooperation
Ask the customer to extend the project deadline to allow time for conflict resolution
Ask the mayor of the city to use their authority to stop neighborhood resistance

x.en:
Here depends the importance of the project manager's role in dealing with situations. In this scenario, the project manager must do the following

 Analyze the situation and find out what is causing the neighborhood's negative attitude 
 Set up a meeting with neighborhood representatives to win cooperation

q.en: How will the selection of a predicitive project life cycle shape the way the project is carried out? ( Choose three)

en: Business value will be delivered to the customer frequently rather than just at the end of the project
The requirements will be determined upfront before the project execution begins
Cost and time will be fixed , and the project scope will be allowed to vary
A single final product will be delivered at the end of the project
Changes will be constrained to the extend possible

x.en: Traditional / Waterfall / Plan driven / Predictive Project : the project requirements and scope are typically determined during initial project planning . Once the project management Plan is approved , changes are constrained through a robust change management process. The product or result of the project is then typically delivered in its final form at the end of the project.

q.en: During the retrospective ceremony, the agile team is talking about the product owner's expectations not being met. What should the project manager have done at the beginning of the project?

en: Defined the team ground rules and shared project vision
Assessed the capabilities of the agile team and planned for the required training
Communicated project vision and sprint goals clearly to the team
Defined the expected agile team contribution in the creation of the backlog

x.en: Keyword (the product owner's expectations not being met) this mean that visions and goals wasn't clear so rereospective ceremony is for addressing problems and mistake in the last sprint or iteration and this meeting is after iteration review , before the next iteration planning so The project manager should communicated project vision and sprint goals clearly to the team at the begging of the project .

q.en: A project manager is acting as a scrum master in a hybrid project and is dealing with a conflict between team members. What strategy should be used to handle this conflict

en: Sort conflicts into two groups : Positive and negative
Place conflicts into categories: structural and interpersonal
Place conflicts on a shared conflict list and ensure it is visible
Review conflicts during daily scrum so they are handled in a timely manner

x.en: Conflict may have both positive and negative effects on a team. It can help the team operate better by exploring issues more fully, but it can lead to emotional problems that damage communication.

q.en:
In a multinational project, stakeholders are in different time zones. The project manager has regular project update meetings with the stakeholders. However , a group of stakeholders who have never attended project update meetings is complaining to the project sponsor that they know very little about the project.
What should the project manager do?

en: Change the meeting time ti the working time zones of the stakeholders who are complaining
Ensure that the stakeholders who are complaining are present for the next project update meetings
Discuss the issue with all stakeholders and work on a communications management plan to meet all stakeholder requirements.
Record the regular project update meeting and share it with all stakeholders after the meeting is completed.

x.en: A group of stakeholders who have never attended project update meetings and they know very little about the project so the project manager should Discuss the issue with all stakeholders and work on a communications management plan to meet all stakeholder requirements.

q.en: Yahya is a project manager who is starting a project using a hybrid approach. Yahya has requested a senior team member to perform a quantitative risk analysis the team member responds that they do not have the knowledge to perform such as analysis. What should Yahya do ?

en: Help the team member to perform the quantitative risk analysis through coaching , mentoring and training
Contact the project management office (PMO) and request them to assign another team member who has the knowledge to perform this task to the team
Perform the quantitative risk analysis for the team member
Escalate the issue to the functional manager

x.en: The project manager should develop the team . the team memeber mentioned that they donot have the knowledge so the project manager should help the team member to perform the quantitative risk analysis theough coaching , mentoring and training.

q.en: You are responsible for designing a new lessons learned management system for an organization. As a part of the project, you need to consult with a number of senior stakeholders and assess their needs and requirements. You then have to facilitate consensus on the system features, workflows, processes and procedures. Once the system is developed, it has to be rolled out across the organization and all employees have to be trained in effective use of the system. You have chosen to use a hybrid project life cycle. Which of the following life cycles should be adopted for the user training phase of the project?

en: Agile
Incremental
Iterative
Predictive

x.en: Once the system is successfully designed and built, user training may be an extensive task but this can well be planned in advance. Predictive life cycle should be the most structured approach for this phase of the project. [Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition, Page 26]

q.en: A stakeholder who was incorrectly classified as a supporter is now reluctant and the project manager becomes worried. What should the project manager do more carefully in future projects ?

en: Create the stakeholders engagement assessment matrix
Develop interpersonal skills to manage stakeholder expectations
Conduct a meeting with senior management
Identify stakeholder

x.en: A stakeholder engagement assessment matrix supports the comparison between the current engagement levels required for successful project delivery . The stakeholder engagement assessment matrix , shown in figure displays gaps between current and desired engagement levels of individual stakeholders. PMBOK 6th edition PG,521

q.en: Which of the following is the management framework that emerges when teams employ Scrum as the chosen way of working and use the Kanban Method as a lens through which to view, understand, and continuously improve how they work?

en: Scrumban
Task Board
WIP
Scrum of Kanban

x.en:
Scrumban is an Agile approach originally designed as a way to transition from Scrum to Kanban. As additional Agile frameworks and methodologies emerged, it became an evolving hybrid framework in and of itself where teams use Scrum as a framework and Kanban for process improvement.

[Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition, Page 108]

q.en: A self-organizing team was delivering as commited . The team accepted a development task with new technology and the iterations started to have reduced velocity. What management decision is suited for this situation ?

en: Add new members to the team and increase the velocity
Move team members who are not performing from the team.
Provide opportunity for team members to learn and adjust to the technology
Re-assign the project to a team that has worked with this technology

x.en: A self-organizing team in Agile environment . The management should provide safe environment for team to enable them to learn and adjust so the best option Provide opportunity for team members to learn and adjust to the technology

q.en: A project manager is assigned to a project in a company that is transitioning to agile . Not all stakeholders believe in the project , and some stakeholders would like the entire project defined and planned out early in the project. However , the project sponsor needs a quick win to ensure the continuation of the project. What approach should the project manager use?

en: A hybrid project as this will mitigate stakeholders' concerns
A predictive approach as this would please the senior stakeholders
An Agile approach as this would provide working functionality earlier
A predictive approach as this will show benefits for all stakeholders

x.en:
Very Important Question in Real Exam 
The hybrid method is used when

 There is a disagreement between the stakeholders on the methodology used.
 When a company moves from a traditional to agile , it must first work in a hybrid environment for a while to empower the team and create a new mindset.
 
 In this scenario some stakeholders would like the entire project defined and planned out early in the project (this Predicitve Approach) and the project sponsor needs a quick win to ensure the continuation of the project (This Agile Approach) , so the project manager should use A hybrid (mix of prdicitive , Agile Approach) project as this will mitigate stakeholders' concerns

q.en: A project is being executed . The project's life cycle is defined as predictive ; however a major deliverable will be handed over incrementally to the customer. The assigned resources are experienced and reliable and are willing to make decisions that the project manager used to make after each incremental delivery on other projects. What should the project manager do ?

en: Schedule a steering committee meeting and obtain their approval on the request
Consult the product owner about letting the resources make decisions
Inform the team that although this is a hybrid environment , the project manager must still be responsible for making decisions
Support the decisions of the team and transfer the decision-making responsibility to them.

x.en: A major deliverable will be handed over incrementally to the customer this means that this is Agile approach and this approach is the team self-organizing team so the project manager should Support the decisions of the team and transfer the decision-making responsibility to them.

q.en: A hybrid project has just deployed , and the project manager is planning project closure with lessons learned workshops. A key stakeholder informs the project manager that having the scrum team in the workshops is a waste of time because the project was delivered successfully. What should the project manager do?

en: Invite the scrum team members as mandatory participants
Ask the scrum master to attend the workshops
Invite the scrum team members as optional participants
Ask the scrum team members to share retrospectives

x.en: keyword (lessons learned) and retrospectives are meeting to discuss the performance to Identify how to improve teamwork by reflecting on what worked, what didn’t, and why (root causes). We recommend running a Retrospective with team every couple of weeks or at the end of a project milestone as lessons learned

q.en: A customer is concerned about the time required to complete a project is asking the project team to reduce the number of iterations required to complete the product. Which approach should the project manager take ?

en: Ask the team to challenge the project estimations for faster delivery
Prioritize deliverables based on business value and define frequent releases
Prioritize the tasks with high risks to reduce the number of iterations required
Ask the team to raise blockers or impediments in daily meetings
