Revise the project management plan and move the task to a time when the technical resource will be available.

x.en: The project manager identified a risk where a technical resource for a critical path item may not be available when needed So the project manager should Consult the risk register for an appropriate planned risk response and implement.

q.en: A team has just adopted an agile approach. During daily standup meetings, the team expressed concerns about task delays. The project leader worked with the product owner to get clarity on the features. The project leader asked the team to fast-track all product features to ensure delivery. Sprints are being completed but with either fewer features or low quality. What should the project leader have done to ensure success?

en: Empowered the team to improve their processes, tools, and interactions to be more effective in delivery and removing impediments
Directed teams to possible solutions that help in removing the impediments and contribute to a timely delivery
Suggested to the team to add impediments as work items in the product backlog to be fixed in the next sprints
Asked the team to create an impediment log and keep it updated for use in the next sprint planning

x.en: Project leader/ Scrum master is servant leader so he should empower the team to solve to improve their processes. The team in agile approach is self organized.

q.en:
A project team member is having difficulty delivering assigned tasks for a project that is at risk of being delayed. The main issue is that the team member does not understand a new system that was recently implemented.
What should the project manager do

en: Ask the team member to learn the new system as on-the-job training.
Issue a change request to extend the project schedule
Escalate the team member's performance to the project sponsor
Assign an experienced resource to support the team member

x.en: The Best option (Ask the team member to learn the new system as on-the-job training. )

q.en: During the third iteration of a project, the product owner requests another mandatory feature. This also happened in the previous two sprints, which resulted in failure and caused frustration within the team. What should the project manager do next?

en: Call for an internal meeting to discuss the changes and their value
Ask the product owner to prioritize the backlog with the project team
Request the scrum team to prioritize the product backlog
Incorporate the changes in the last sprint before the first release

x.en: The team could've accepted the PO's requests previously without analyzing the impact of the changes, which resulted in failures. This time the team should discuss the changes first and then make a proper decision. Also in accordance Agile principles, the team shouldn't accept any new features in the middle of the sprint.

q.en:
A company is implementing a project with team members located in different countries and time zones. Individual performance is satisfactory, but the team's performance as a whole is low, especially in terms of group activities.
What should the project manager do?

en: Facilitate communication and team building
Negotiate for new team members
Review and reassign team assignments
Review and update the communications management plan

x.en: As group activities performance is low and team members located in different countries and time zones, thus they need more chances to communicate, team building is a good idea. Good communicate will improve team work as agroup

q.en:
A project team has expressed concern that certain remote team members are not able to collaborate with the larger project team due to their work schedule. The project manager is confused since the entire team is located in the same time zone and believes there are other factors at play.
What should the project manager do next?

en: Examine the team's virtual needs
Implement new options
Rectify ground rule violations
Review performance formally

x.en: Project manager need to find out (examine) the issues first before you can rectify anything. It may just be technical issues or other things

q.en:
A project manager is working with a customer's team on a new project. Some product definitions and requirements are still not clear, but the customer wants to start activities as soon as possible. The organization is also expecting product delivery for a specific date due to a regulatory requirement. Due to the nature of the project, the project manager has decided to use a hybrid approach.
Why did the project manager choose a hybrid approach?

en: A hybrid approach will allow for management of the requirement uncertainties as well as the date restriction
A hybrid approach will allow the project manager to revise the product specifications
A hybrid approach will enable project activities to start immediately and allow for a plan for the requirements definitions
A hybrid approach will ensure the delivery date is accomplished and will eliminate product uncertainties

x.en: Without knowing what is the requirement, as a project manager you cannot plan or schedule. Scope of a project comes from requirements. Schedule development can only be done scope is defined and validated - because it is Hybrid.

q.en: A project manager is part of a team that is launching a series of features to comply with a new regulation. The team has only 6 weeks to release the features to the legacy applications. During the standup meeting, a software engineer indicated that the development of an important feature is on hold until the assigned designer completes a specific task. This delay is a serious road block to meeting the release date. What should the project manager do?

en: Meet with the design team manager to inform them of the current status and request an additional designer
Ask the software engineer to move forward without completing the important feature
Meet with the designer to share the current status and develop a solution to complete the task
Contact the design team manager and ask to reconsider the priority list based on the latest situation

x.en: Always prefer face to face discussion. And involve the person/team. Team are self organized

q.en: A team is delivering features to a customer at every iteration. After completing each iteration, the customer is invited for a review. However, the customer is frequently not available and the review is often delayed, which results in increased rework for the team. What should the project manager do?

en: Request the customer to clarify all requirements at the start of each iteration
Ask the customer to review the deliverables in each iteration based on their availability
Include the customer in daily project activities to gain the required guidance
Plan ahead and define the best way to review the deliverables with the customer

x.en: It is important for the project manager to plan ahead and find a way to review the deliverables with the customer that is efficient and effective, despite the customer's availability. This could involve scheduling regular review sessions in advance, using online collaboration tools to facilitate remote reviews, or finding other ways to ensure that the customer is able to provide timely feedback. By proactively addressing the issue of customer availability, the project manager can help to minimize rework and ensure that the team is able to make progress efficiently.

q.en:
A project team consisting of four team members will be rolling out a company-wide application to both staff and contractors in a country. To deliver within strict the time lines, a local company skilled in application deployment and change management will need to be contracted.
What should the project manager do to empower the local company?

en: Begin to roll out the application by micromanaging the contractor
Manage expectations and agree on the requirements that the contractor will deliver under the supervision of the project manager
Set expectations and agree on the requirements that the contractor will deliver with periodic progress reports
Deploy the contractor's staff under the supervision of the project manager

x.en: Project manager should Manage expectations and agree on the requirements that the contractor will deliver under the supervision of the project manager

q.en: A project manager is managing a construction project that is facing challenges. There is schedule overrun, cost overrun, and the client is unhappy with the specific scope progress. What should the project manager do first?

en: Take action to reduce the cost overrun
Review the scope and project objectives.
Enforce the penalty clause on the supplier
Work with the client on the scope completion

x.en: If the Customer is unhappy about the scope it's better review it

q.en:
In a geographically distributed project team, the project team members continue to email status reports and update schedules after their weekly meeting discussions. However, the team is having difficulty tracking the changes and progress made.
What should the project manager do?

en: Develop a document management software for version control
Maintain separate document control via regions to avoid discrepancies.
Facilitate training on version control and project artifacts.
Maintain a central repository of artifacts with a version control system

x.en: The correct Answer ( Maintain a central repository of artifacts with a version control system)

q.en: A project manager has been assigned to a project where collaboration with the business is a critical key factor. The project manager is not sure about which approach to use. A senior project manager has been assigned to help the project manager. What advice should the senior project manager provide?

en: Establish a project management methodology that requires the customer to provide daily updates to the team
Suggest using an agile approach since customer and team collaboration is critical for project success
Provide a project management template for the project manager to follow as a guide
Work with the project manager to develop a new approach that will bring benefits to the project

x.en:
Keyword (collaboration with the business is a critical key factor) so the Agile approach is the best .
Agile Values 

 Individuals and interactions over processes and tools.
 Working software over comprehensive documentation.
 Customer collaboration over contract negotiation.
 Responding to change over following a plan

q.en: A project manager is managing a large project. A stakeholder has just discovered a new risk that has not been identified in earlier stages. What should the project manager do?

en: Confirm to the stakeholder that the risk register has been completed and validated by all stakeholders
Perform a risk analysis directly with the stakeholder who raised the risk and update the risk register
Add the risk to the risk register and reevaluate the register with help from the project team and stakeholders
Communicate the risk to the steering committee and request a mitigation plan from senior management

x.en: Any new risk that is discovered, the project manager must add / update the risk register and then conduct a risk analysis to prioritize the risks to develop effective response plans for the risks according to their priorities

q.en: A Scrum team is analyzing the burndown chart on day four of a 15-day sprint. The burndown chart is shown below. What should the team do next?

en: Ask the project team to select any additional stories as they have additional capacity than planned
Continue with the sprint work as planned and keep monitoring
Continue with the sprint as the progress shows buffers for potential interruptions
Ask the product owner if some low-priority stories could be cut from the sprint

x.en: It's just day 4 of 15 days sprint. it's too early to take any action. Monitoring will be appropriate

q.en: A project manager is closing a project and preparing to hand it over to the operations team. During handover, a delayed invoice was submitted with a higher-than- planned cost against the project work. Consequently, project handover was delayed and the project's reported completion costs were increased. What should the project manager have done to avoid this situation?

en: Involved the finance team and discussed the issue with the vendor
Reviewed the total committed cost against the cost invoiced at project closing
Captured and reviewed all of the project work and related costs regularly
Notified all vendors about the invoicing and nonpayment deadlines

x.en: The project manager should Captured and reviewed all of the project work and related costs regularly to avoid the delay and increasing of cost.

q.en: A project manager is working with a co-located agile project team that has worked together long enough to be in the performing phase of team development. An unforeseen event has caused the team to be dispersed and they are now unable to co-locate. What should the project manager do to keep the team performing as effectively as possible

en: Provide the team with virtual collaboration software and training on the software to minimize disruption
Transition the team from an agile approach to a predictive approach for better performance control
Ask the project sponsor and executive stakeholders to encourage the team to maintain their performance
Evaluate project performance and step in if performance decreases to an unacceptable level

x.en: The team is in the performing stage of Tuckman, they are self-organizing and they can work through issues smoothly and effectively. What the Project manager need to do is monitor their performance to be sure they are still performing as they usually do, and, if there is a drop in performance, the team will be notified, and they will discuss to proffered a solution to the drop in performance
